original_test_intent: Verify all expected TEMP_NV_NIC_EW1 through EWN sensors are correctly mapped to their physical east-west network adapters and ports and report human-readable temperature, status and thresholds matching the approved NIC thermal specification.
original_method: Enumerate the complete EW adapter/port population and immutable BMC raw/UI identities, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized adapter identity, health, link state, traffic counters and passive airflow context, and compare each result to the owner thermal and correlation rules.
manual_activity: The owner provides EW adapter/port/sensor mapping, thermal limits and any adapter-telemetry correlation rule; an operator verifies raw/UI/adapter identity and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and EW1..EWN NIC adapter/port inventory
Physical EW adapter/port to PCIe/BDF/MAC and SDR/Redfish/UI sensor mapping
Temperature unit/scale/warning/critical threshold and expected range specification
Approved BMC-versus-adapter temperature relationship plus read-only health/link/traffic/airflow context
UI refresh/rounding/lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never generate unapproved traffic or change link speed, NIC power, fan, threshold or thermal policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each sample to immutable adapter/port identity and synchronized link/load context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on NIC health/link/thermal alarm, stale/impossible value, missing/duplicate mapping or cooling fault
Do not assume BMC and adapter temperatures must match or retry after changing traffic
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify all EW NIC adapter, port and sensor mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with read-only context
Assist with synchronized WebUI and approved same-adapter telemetry capture/normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, mapping or raw/UI/adapter/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no network load/policy mutation or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative EW topology, thermal limits and BMC/adapter correlation rules
Review adapter identity, sensor location, link/load timing and raw/UI discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool may expose a BMC record, but a literal TEMP_NV_NIC_EW1~N name and head-limited fallback cannot prove all EW adapters/ports, complete thresholds, UI presentation or same-adapter link/load context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate complete BMC sensors and NIC inventory, join each owner-mapped EW adapter/port to immutable identities, capture full read-only metadata/context, then correlate WebUI and any approved adapter telemetry under the timing specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_NV_NIC_EW1~N scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED EAST-WEST NIC TEMPERATURE VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-adapter matrix of EW designation, PCIe/BDF/MAC/ports, BMC sensor identity/value/threshold and UI display, plus health/link/traffic/airflow and approved adapter telemetry with timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable adapter/port mapping and passive network context while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and load generation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One sensor value or screenshot cannot cover EW1..EWN or prove the intended adapter. Every expected EW adapter/sensor must be reconciled independently of the NS group.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NIC internal and board-level BMC sensors can differ by placement and traffic/link state; only owner-defined source and timing semantics support correlation.

project_override_considerations: If EW labels refer to fabric roles rather than fixed slots, the owner must provide the current role-to-adapter identity mapping; NS or NVMe temperature evidence cannot fill missing EW coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/EW NIC topology/thermal spec revision
Per-EW adapter/port to PCIe/BDF/MAC and raw/UI sensor identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI and approved adapter telemetry with source/location/lag comparison
Per-adapter discrepancies, no-load/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target EW NIC temperatures and thresholds. Exact role/adapter mapping and telemetry correlation are project inputs rather than contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: EW topology, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/adapter-context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Makes the EW role-to-physical-adapter identity and passive link/load context explicit for complete, source-aware thermal validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: EW can denote a logical fabric role rather than a permanent slot, so evidence must bind the role to BDF, MAC, ports and BMC sensor at collection time. Link state and traffic affect adapter temperature, while BMC and NIC-internal sensors can sit at different locations and polling intervals. A successful generic read cannot prove any of those associations. NS-group evidence remains separate because its topology and airflow path may differ.
